import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_2/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_2/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_2_0 and Source2_2_1 on 'calaccess_committee_id'
# Both have this column, join on it
df_joined = pd.merge(
    df0,
    df1[['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_position']],
    on='calaccess_committee_id',
    how='inner'
)

# Group by contributor_firstname, contributor_lastname, committee_position and sum amount
df_grouped = (
    df_joined
    .groupby(['contributor_firstname', 'contributor_lastname', 'committee_position'], dropna=False, as_index=False)
    .agg({'amount': 'sum'})
)

# Ensure columns have correct types and names as per target schema
# Target schema: ['contributor_firstname': string, 'contributor_lastname': string, 'committee_position': string, 'amount': float]

# Convert contributor_firstname and contributor_lastname to string, fill NaN with empty string to match target style
df_grouped['contributor_firstname'] = df_grouped['contributor_firstname'].fillna('').astype(str)
df_grouped['contributor_lastname'] = df_grouped['contributor_lastname'].fillna('').astype(str)
df_grouped['committee_position'] = df_grouped['committee_position'].fillna('').astype(str)
df_grouped['amount'] = df_grouped['amount'].astype(float)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_2/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_2/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_2/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on calaccess_committee_id
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    left_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    right_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=("", "_y")
)

# Group by contributor_firstname, contributor_lastname, committee_position and sum amount
result = (
    joined.groupby(
        ["contributor_firstname", "contributor_lastname", "committee_position"],
        dropna=False,
        as_index=False,
    )
    .agg({"amount": "sum"})
)

# Write output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv(
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_2/target_multisource_critique_history.csv",
    index=False,
)
